title: Repeat-Cancellation Administration Charge
content:
**Q. What is the repeat-cancellation administration charge?**
A. A charge taken off the cancellation refund of a Northgate Memberships membership when the member has earlier raised a cancellation request and withdrawn it. The refund never goes below zero.

**Q. What is the rule?**
A. A cancellation request the member raised in the twelve months before the cancellation, by its request date, and later withdrew carries a repeat-cancellation administration charge of 10.00 dollars, one raised 12 to 23 whole months before and later withdrawn carries 5.00 dollars, and none carries nothing.

**Q. How are the months counted?**
A. From the request date of the withdrawn cancellation request to the cancellation date, in whole calendar months. "In the twelve months before" means fewer than 12 whole months; "12 to 23 whole months" means at least 12 and fewer than 24.

| Withdrawn cancellation request, by request date | Charge |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 whole months before the cancellation | 10.00 |
| none within 12 months; one 12 to 23 whole months before | 5.00 |
| none, or only ones 24 or more whole months before | nothing |

**Q. Hypothetical: a request raised 5 whole months ago and withdrawn?**
A. 10.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: a request raised 18 whole months ago and withdrawn, nothing since?**
A. 5.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: a request raised 3 months ago that was confirmed rather than withdrawn?**
A. Only withdrawn requests count — nothing on its account.
